reviewNote: Recipes have not been reviewed by a dietitian, clinician or food-safety specialist. Nutrition is withheld (null) until per-serving values are calculated from weighed ingredients and reviewed; set nutrition.verified=true only after that review.

meals.name: Jamaican Ackee & Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Heat olive oil in pan
Sauté bell pepper and scallion 2 min
Gently fold in the drained canned ackee and heat through for 2–3 min
Push to the side and scramble the eggs until firm
Mix together, season with pepper
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Callaloo & Sweet Potato Hash
instructions: Steam sweet potato 10 min until tender
Heat coconut oil, sauté onion and garlic
Add callaloo, cook 5 min
Add sweet potato, mix well
Season with thyme

meals.name: Coconut Chia Pudding with Mango
instructions: Mix chia seeds with coconut milk
Refrigerate overnight
Top with mango and coconut
Drizzle with vanilla extract

meals.name: Jerk Spiced Tofu Scramble
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water
Heat oil, sauté vegetables
Add tofu and jerk seasoning
Cook 8-10 min until golden
Stir in nutritional yeast

meals.name: Green Banana Porridge with Cinnamon
instructions: Grate green banana
Bring almond milk to simmer
Whisk in banana, cook 10 min
Add cinnamon and flaxseed
Stir until thickened

meals.name: Protein Pumpkin Pancakes
instructions: Mix all ingredients in bowl
Heat coconut oil in pan
Pour batter, cook about 3 min per side until set in the centre
Serve warm

meals.name: Jamaican Breakfast Bowl (Yam, Banana, Ackee)
instructions: Boil yam and banana until tender
Gently heat the drained canned ackee in a pan for 2–3 min
Arrange on plate with avocado
Drizzle with olive oil
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Avocado & Saltfish on Toast
ingredients: 1/4 cup saltfish, soaked overnight (or boiled 15–20 min), rinsed and flaked
instructions: After desalting according to the product instructions, cook the saltfish until a food thermometer reads 145°F (63°C) in the thickest part; then flake it.
Toast bread
Mix avocado with lime juice
Spread on toast
Top with the flaked saltfish and tomato
Season with pepper

meals.name: Tropical Fruit & Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt and fruits in glass
Top with nuts and chia seeds
Drizzle with honey if desired

meals.name: Jamaican Cornmeal Porridge
instructions: Mix cornmeal with cold milk
Bring to boil, add cinnamon
Simmer 15 min, stirring
Remove cinnamon, add flavorings

meals.name: Ackee & Saltfish Salad
instructions: Drain the canned ackee gently so it keeps its shape.
Desalt the saltfish according to the product instructions, then cook until a food thermometer in the thickest part reads 145°F (63°C). Rinse as directed and flake; soaking alone does not cook fish.
In a bowl, combine greens, cucumber, avocado.
Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic 30 sec, add ackee and saltfish, warm through (2-3 min).
Place ackee-saltfish mix over greens.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, pepper for dressing, drizzle.
Garnish with scallion.
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Chicken & Callaloo Egg Muffins
ingredients: ½ cup cooked chicken, shredded (cooked to 165°F / 74°C)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Whisk eggs with coconut milk, turmeric, pepper.
Stir in chicken, callaloo, bell pepper, scallion.
Spray muffin tin with olive oil.
Pour mixture into 6 muffin cups.
Bake 18–20 min until set and a thermometer in the centre reads 165°F (74°C).
Cool 5 min before removing.

meals.name: Sardine & Vegetable Skillet
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (zucchini, bell pepper, onion)
instructions: Heat olive oil in large skillet.
Sauté garlic and vegetables 5-7 min until tender.
Add sardines with their oil, break into chunks.
Season with Jamaican seasoning, thyme, pepper.
Cook 3-4 min until heated through.
Drizzle with lime juice before serving.

meals.name: Jerk Chicken & Cabbage Stir-fry
instructions: Season chicken with jerk seasoning.
Heat oil in wok or large pan.
Stir-fry chicken 5–6 min until no longer pink and it reaches 165°F (74°C).
Remove chicken, add more oil if needed.
Stir-fry cabbage and carrot 3-4 min.
Return chicken to pan, add water, cook 2 min.
Serve hot.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Ackee & Tofu Scramble
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water, crumble.
Heat oil, sauté onion until translucent.
Add tomato, cook 2 min.
Add ackee and tofu, gently stir.
Season with turmeric, thyme, pepper.
Cook 5-7 min until heated through.
safetyNotes: Use commercially canned ackee only. Unripe or incorrectly prepared ackee contains a toxin (hypoglycin) that cooking does not destroy, so don't prepare fresh ackee unless you have been trained to do so safely.

meals.name: Callaloo & Egg White Frittata
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté callaloo, bell pepper, garlic in oil 3 min.
Whisk egg whites with nutritional yeast, pepper.
Pour over vegetables in oven-safe dish.
Bake 12–15 min until set and the centre reads 160°F (71°C).
Let cool 5 min before slicing.

meals.name: Protein Power Bowl: Beans & Greens
instructions: Arrange greens in bowl.
Top with beans, corn, avocado.
Sprinkle pumpkin seeds.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, cumin for dressing.
Drizzle over bowl.

meals.name: Green Smoothie Bowl (Post-workout)
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Pour into bowl.
Top with additional berries and seeds.
Enjoy immediately.

meals.name: Jamaican Chicken Salad Wrap
ingredients: ½ cup cooked chicken, shredded (cooked to 165°F / 74°C and chilled)
instructions: Mix chicken with jerk seasoning and lime juice.
Warm tortilla if desired.
Spread Greek yogurt on tortilla.
Layer greens, chicken, avocado.
Roll tightly and slice.

meals.name: Pumpkin & Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery in pot 5 min.
Add pumpkin, lentils, broth, and spices.
Bring to boil, then simmer 20-25 min.
Blend partially for creamier texture.
Season to taste.

meals.name: Steamed Fish with Okra & Pumpkin
instructions: Season fish with salt and thyme
Place in pot with okra and pumpkin
Add scallion and scotch bonnet
Steam over medium heat 15–20 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C)

meals.name: Jerk Chicken over Spinach Salad
instructions: Coat chicken with jerk seasoning
Grill or pan-fry about 6 min per side until it reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part
Slice and place over spinach
Add avocado and tomatoes
Dress with lime juice and olive oil
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Curried Chickpea & Callaloo
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil
Add curry powder, toast 1 min
Add chickpeas, coat well
Add callaloo, cook 5 min
Season and serve

meals.name: Jamaican Salmon with Pumpkin & Greens
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Rub salmon with jerk seasoning, thyme, black pepper.
Place salmon on a baking sheet and bake 12–15 min until it flakes easily and reaches 145°F (63°C).
Steam pumpkin cubes 10-12 min until tender.
Heat olive oil in pan, sauté garlic 30 sec, add bok choy and green beans, cook 4-5 min until vibrant.
Plate salmon with pumpkin and greens.
Squeeze lemon over everything.

meals.name: Tuna & Avocado Stuffed Sweet Potato
instructions: Bake sweet potato at 400°F (200°C) for 45–50 min until tender.
Let cool slightly, then slice open.
Mix tuna with avocado, Greek yogurt, lime juice, paprika.
Stuff sweet potato with tuna mixture.
Garnish with scallion and pepper.

meals.name: Fish Tea with Pumpkin & Okra
instructions: Bring water to boil in large pot.
Add fish, pumpkin, okra, carrot, scallion, thyme, and whole scotch bonnet.
Simmer 20–25 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C).
Remove scotch bonnet.
Add lime juice, season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot.

meals.name: Curry Goat with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Marinate goat meat with curry powder 30 min.
Heat oil, brown meat on all sides.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, sauté 5 min.
Add water and simmer 1.5–2 hours until the meat is very tender and a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 160°F (71°C).
Let the meat rest for at least 3 minutes before serving.
Serve over cauliflower rice.

meals.name: Steamed Fish with Cho-Cho & Carrots
instructions: Season fish with Jamaican seasoning.
Arrange vegetables in steamer basket.
Place fish on top.
Steam 15–20 min until a food thermometer in the thickest part of the fish reads 145°F (63°C).
Drizzle with olive oil before serving.

meals.name: Oven-Roasted Chicken with Root Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss vegetables with oil and seasoning.
Arrange chicken and vegetables on baking sheet.
Roast 35–40 min until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.
Serve hot.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Ground Turkey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté turkey, onion and garlic until no pink remains and the turkey reaches 165°F (74°C).
Mix with cauliflower rice and tomato sauce.
Stuff bell pepper halves.
Bake 25-30 min until peppers are tender.
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.

meals.name: Jerk Pork with Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Marinate pork in jerk marinade 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roast pork 25–30 min until it reaches 145°F (63°C) in the centre.
Toss vegetables with oil and thyme, roast alongside.
Rest pork at least 3 min before slicing.

meals.name: Callaloo & Saltfish Patties
ingredients: ½ cup saltfish, soaked overnight (or boiled 15–20 min), rinsed and flaked
instructions: Steam callaloo until wilted, squeeze out excess water.
Mix with saltfish, egg, almond flour, thyme, scallion.
Form into patties.
Heat oil and cook patties 3–4 min per side until golden and firm in the centre (160°F / 71°C).
Drain on paper towels.

meals.name: Jamaican Oxtail Stew (Lean)
instructions: Brown oxtail in pot.
Add onion, carrots, garlic, sauté 5 min.
Add broth, browning sauce, thyme, pimento, scotch bonnet.
Simmer 2.5–3 hours until the meat is very tender and a food thermometer in the thickest part reads at least 160°F (71°C).
Let the meat rest for at least 3 minutes before serving.
Remove scotch bonnet before serving.

meals.name: Grilled Snapper with Steamed Veg
instructions: Marinate fillet in lemon, garlic and thyme
Grill about 5 min per side until opaque and it reaches 145°F (63°C)
Steam broccoli and carrots 8 min
Plate with a drizzle of olive oil

meals.name: Jamaican Brown Stew Tofu
instructions: Press and cube tofu, pat dry
Brown in oil until golden
Add onion, garlic, pimento
Stir in browning and soy sauce
Simmer in 1/4 cup water 10 min

meals.name: Herb-Crusted Turkey Breast
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C)
Mix herbs, garlic and oil into a paste
Rub all over the turkey breast
Roast until the thickest part reaches 165°F (74°C), about 30–40 min for a 1 lb breast (longer for larger cuts)
Rest 5 min before slicing
safetyNotes: Check poultry with a food thermometer: it is safe at 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part.
